name: VAT and Carousel Fraud
description: Missing-trader and carousel schemes exploit VAT refund and cross-border zero-rating rules by creating chains of invoices and trades where the VAT collected is never remitted. Common goods include electronics, metals, and emissions allowances; flows are fast, circular and between thinly capitalised companies.

sources.text: Europol and EU bodies, public material on missing trader intra-community (MTIC) fraud
OECD, Technology Tools to Tackle Tax Evasion and Tax Fraud (2017)
FATF/OECD, Money Laundering Awareness Handbook for Tax Examiners and Tax Auditors (2012)
Council Directive 2006/112/EC on the common system of value added tax

indicators.name: Newly formed company with rapid high-value cross-border trading
indicators.canon: Newly established customer with rapid high-value activity
indicators.desc: A recently formed customer with little history or track record quickly records large turnover or trades in high-value or restricted goods.
indicators.ctx: Company with minimal history, few staff and basic premises records large intra-EU or cross-border turnover quickly.
indicators.fp: Fast-growing start-ups and trading vehicles exist.

indicators.name: Circular payment flows among related counterparties
indicators.canon: Circular or round-trip flows among related parties
indicators.desc: Funds or goods-linked payments loop back to the originator or between related counterparties, or are traded back and forth.
indicators.ctx: Funds return to origin after passing through several companies in a chain within days.
indicators.fp: Group treasury or back-to-back trading may be similar.

indicators.name: Goods are high-value, low-weight and easily moved
indicators.canon: Goods are high-value, low-weight and easily moved
indicators.desc: Trade in mobile phones, chips, precious metals, or CO2 allowances with no storage or transport evidence.
indicators.ctx: Trade in mobile phones, chips, precious metals, or CO2 allowances with no storage or transport evidence.
indicators.fp: These goods are legitimate high-volume trade lines.

indicators.name: Payments in and out the same day with thin margin
indicators.canon: Payments in and out the same day with thin margin
indicators.desc: Funds received from buyer are paid onward to supplier, often same day, leaving little retained.
indicators.ctx: Funds received from buyer are paid onward to supplier, often same day, leaving little retained.
indicators.fp: Distributors and agents may operate on thin margins and pass-through.

indicators.name: Payments to or from jurisdictions unrelated to goods
indicators.canon: Payments or activity in jurisdictions unrelated to the customer's business or goods
indicators.desc: Payments, counterparties or sales originate in or go to countries with no link to the customer, declared business, services or goods.
indicators.ctx: Counterparties are in different countries from the goods' origin or destination, often via third-country accounts.
indicators.fp: Complex supply chains cause legitimate triangulation.

indicators.name: Directors or addresses linked to prior defaulted VAT companies
indicators.canon: Short-lived or rotating entities with common controllers
indicators.desc: Entities are repeatedly formed, abandoned or replaced by successors sharing directors, addresses or history of prior defaulted companies.
indicators.ctx: Officers or premises previously appeared in VAT-defaulting entities or liquidations.
indicators.fp: Directors can have genuine business failures.

indicators.name: Invoices with identical formats across 'unrelated' suppliers
indicators.canon: Invoices with identical formats across 'unrelated' suppliers
indicators.desc: Documents share templates, wording or bank accounts across different companies.
indicators.ctx: Documents share templates, wording or bank accounts across different companies.
indicators.fp: Accounting software may produce similar templates.

indicators.name: Sudden stop of activity and withdrawal of funds before VAT due
indicators.canon: Sudden stop of activity and withdrawal of funds before VAT due
indicators.desc: Account activity ceases and balances drain just before VAT returns fall due.
indicators.ctx: Account activity ceases and balances drain just before VAT returns fall due.
